title: Transposon insertion sequencing (Tn-seq) library preparation protocol
author: Nagendra Palani
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.w9sfh6e
materials: This section of the protocol is from the manual for NEB Ultra II FS kit - Catalog # E7805. (Refer to https://www.neb.com/-/media/catalog/datacards-or-manuals/manuale7805.pdf : Section for Input > 100 ng for detailed protocol) Aliquot 100 ng of genomic DNA into a well of a 96-well plate and use 1x TE to bring the volume to 26 µL . Add the NEBNext Ultra II FS buffer + enzyme mix to the DNA (follow protocol from the linked manual) Set up the following program on the thermal cycler 75 °C, heated lid 37 °C for 00:15:00 65 °C for 00:30:00 4 °C hold. This should fragment the library to have a distribution between 200 - 450 bp. Add the NEBNext Ultra II ligation mix + enhancer to the well. Add 2.5 µL of the adaptor to the mixture. Mix well and incubate at 20 °C for 00:15:00, heated lid off . Post incubation, add 28.5 µL of 0.1x TE and bring volume to 100 µL . Perform bead clean-up of the ligation mix using the sample purification beads that came with the kit. Use 30 µL of beads for 1st bead addition 15 µL of beads for 2nd bead addition (to select for an insert size distribution of 200 - 350 bp). Elute in 10 µL of dH 2 O.

Make 10 uM dilutions of the following primers. Transposon_Enrich_Fwd Transposon_Enrich_Rev For each sample set up the following PCR in a 96-well plate. Transposon - genome junction enrichment 7.5 µL, Adaptor ligated DNA 12.5 µL, Ultra II Q5 master mix 2.5 µL, Transposon_Enrich_Fwd 2.5 µL, Transposon_Enrich_Rev Run the following program on a thermal cycler. Use the NEB Tm Calculator to calculate the primer Tm values. If recommended Tm is greater than 65 ºC, use 65 ºC in the annealing & extension step below. For the Q5 master mix that comes with the NEB Ultra II FS kit (or the separately bought version), NEB recommends a combined annealing + extension step at 65 ºC. If your enrichment primers require a different annealing temperature, you can use the standard Q5 protocol (anneal at primer Tm, extend at 72 ºC). See here for more information). The number of PCR cycles needs to be decided by the user to get enough enriched DNA for indexing. Lower number of cycles is better to maintain sequence diversity. 98 °C 00:00:30, Initial denaturation - use heated lid 98 °C 00:00:10, Denaturation 65 °C 00:01:15, Annealing & Extension 10 - 15 cycles (to be decided by user) 4 °C, Hold After end of PCR, use 1 µL of the PCR end-product for Picogreen / Qubit. Use 2 µL to run the sample on a Tapestation (D5000 high-sensitivity) to check for library size. Each sample library should be a unimodal distribution between ~ 300 bp - 600 bp. All libraries should have an average size distribution within 15% across all samples.

steps.title: Prepare Oligo Stocks
steps.instruction: Prepare 100 μM stocks of all oligos using 0.1x TE.

steps.title: Prepare Adaptor
steps.instruction: Anneal the TA_Adaptor oligos to form the adaptor.

substeps.instruction: In a 0.2 ml PCR tube, add 15 µL Oligo TA_Adaptor_Top (100 uM), 15 µL Oligo TA_Adaptor_Bottom (100 uM), and 70 µL dH2O (Total 100 µL).
Incubate on a thermal cycler at 95 °C for 00:03:00 with the heated lid on.
Terminate incubation and allow the heat block to cool to room temperature.
Remove the tube and let it sit on the bench for 1 hour to complete annealing.

steps.title: Prepare Indexing Reaction
steps.instruction: Perform the indexing PCR using Enrichment PCR product as the template.

substeps.instruction: Make 10 uM dilutions of Nextera_R1 and Nextera_R2 primers.
For each sample, set up a 25 µL PCR reaction containing: 12.5 µL Ultra II Q5 master mix, 1.25 µL Nextera_R1, 1.25 µL Nextera_R2, 10 ng Template, and dH2O as required.
Run the PCR program: 98 °C for 00:00:30 (Initial Denaturation); 10 cycles of 98 °C for 00:00:10 (Denaturation) and 65 °C for 00:01:30 (Annealing & Extension); Hold at 4 °C.
Use 1 µL of the PCR end-product for Picogreen/Qubit quantification.

steps.title: Pool and Clean-up Libraries
steps.instruction: Pool the samples and perform a bead-based cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Pool samples by equal mass (if library size distributions are similar) or by equal molar mass.

steps.title: Quantify and Dilute Pool
steps.instruction: Quantify the final pool and adjust concentration for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Quantify the library using the Kapa Illumina Library quantification kit.
Dilute the pool to the appropriate molarity required for the sequencing instrument.

steps.title: Sequence the Library
steps.instruction: Load the pool onto the sequencer and run with appropriate parameters.

substeps.instruction: Load the pool on the sequencer (compatible with MiSeq, HiSeq 2500, iSeq, and Novaseq; NextSeq may require more PhiX).
Run with 15% PhiX spike-in for base diversity.
Use paired-end sequencing with at least 100 base read length.
